text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while September jobs came in at a dismal 29,000 — this is a dangerous combo of tightening into a weakening economy, and with CPI expected to rise further to 3.6-3.7%, stagflation risk is real and could pressure your growth and speculative holdings hard.
RGTI is your worst performer at -53%, has deeply negative earnings, revenue declining 34%, and high short interest — the thesis is broken and this needs to go now before it gets worse.
QBTS is down 51% with negative earnings, bearish technicals across the board, and high short interest — there's nothing to hold onto here, sell and redeploy the capital.
MSTR is down 52% and acts as a leveraged Bitcoin bet with negative free cash flow — in a rising-rate environment where speculative assets get hit hardest, reduce your exposure meaningfully.
BMNR is down 58% from its high with three consecutive earnings misses and deteriorating fundamentals — trim what's left to limit further damage.
Adobe at just 8.6x earnings with 10% revenue growth and nearly 11% free cash flow yield is genuinely cheap for a business this strong — add on this pullback while quality names are on sale.
Micron has the best relative strength in your portfolio with 49% revenue growth and a PE of just 4.8 — this is a rare value-plus-momentum combination worth adding to on strength.
